scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && vite build
scripts.start: concurrently --names "dev,php,ws" --prefix-colors "green,yellow,cyan" "npm run dev" "php -d display_errors=1 artisan serve" "php artisan reverb:start"
scripts.types: php artisan scramble:clear && php artisan scramble:export --path=frontend/src/api/api.json && npm run types -w frontend
scripts.pull: git stash && git pull && git stash apply
